Alexander McQueen and Isabella Blow: Fashion, friendship and tragedy
description: 'Sewn and torn' (1/6). Love stories and friendships can sometimes end badly, even in the world of fashion. In the mid-1990s, an almost symbiotic relationship developed between the London-born designer from a working-class background and the broke aristocratic fashion journalist. That bond shattered when McQueen left for Givenchy, marking the end of their closeness – something neither ever truly recovered from.

headline: 'Muslims here are constantly required to prove they are real Spaniards': Ceuta's unprecedented migration crisis:
description: The arrival of 72,000 people from Morocco in the Spanish enclave between July 30 and 31 exposed both the cracks and the bonds of solidarity running through this city, where Christians and Muslims have lived side by side for centuries.

headline: The Golden Owl, the treasure hunt that drives you mad: 'No one listens to anyone anymore'
description: 'The Golden Owl's last secrets' (1/6). Thirty-one years after it was buried, the treasure known as La Chouette d'Or, or Golden Owl, was discovered on the night of October 2, 2024. Yet, many 'chouetteurs' – the name given to the community of treasure hunters obsessed with this elusive statuette – never stopped searching for 'the real one.' Something doesn't add up.
